rules.claim: The document detail notes action is registered for GET, POST, and DELETE and uses PaperlessNotePermissions.
The GET upstream permission class requires documents.view_note and documents.view_document as global model permissions.
Before GET handling, the view checks has_perms_owner_aware(currentUser, view_document, addressed document); failure returns HTTP 403.
The owner-aware object check has an owner-based success branch when the document owner is null or equals the current user.
The owner-aware object check has an object-permission success branch through checker.has_perm(perms, addressed document).
If the owner-aware view_document check fails, GET terminates with HTTP 403 before note representation.
A GET success path serializes the addressed document's notes and returns them in a response.
The document detail notes action is registered for POST and uses PaperlessNotePermissions.
The POST upstream permission class requires documents.add_note, documents.view_document, and documents.change_document as global model permissions.
POST first passes through the owner-aware view_document check on the addressed document; failure returns HTTP 403.
The POST view_document object check can succeed via the document-owner branch when owner is null or equals the current user.
The POST view_document object check can succeed via checker.has_perm(view_document, addressed document).
Inside POST, a second owner-aware check requires change_document on the addressed document; failure returns HTTP 403 before creation.
The change_document owner-aware check can succeed via the document-owner branch when owner is null or equals the current user.
The change_document owner-aware check can succeed via checker.has_perm(change_document, addressed document).
If the initial owner-aware view_document check fails, POST terminates with HTTP 403 before note creation.
If the POST change_document check fails, POST terminates with HTTP 403 and does not create a note.
After both owner-aware checks pass, POST creates a Note attached to the addressed document and returns the serialized notes.

rules.claim: The detail notes action admits GET and is protected by PaperlessNotePermissions.
For GET, the permission class requires authenticated status and global documents.view_note plus documents.view_document permissions.
The addressed document passes the owner-aware view_document check with an addressed-document view_document grant.
The GET path serializes and returns the addressed document's notes.
The detail notes action admits GET and is protected by PaperlessNotePermissions.
For GET, the permission class requires authenticated status and global documents.view_note plus documents.view_document permissions.
The owner-aware helper passes when the addressed document is ownerless or owned by the caller, without requiring the addressed-document object grant.
The GET path serializes and returns the addressed document's notes after the owner-aware check passes.
The detail notes action admits GET and is protected by PaperlessNotePermissions.
GET is rejected when authentication or the global GET permissions required by PaperlessNotePermissions fail.
The view returns HTTP 403 when its addressed-document owner-aware view_document check fails.
The detail notes action admits POST and is protected by PaperlessNotePermissions.
For POST, the permission class requires authenticated status and global documents.add_note, documents.view_document, and documents.change_document permissions.
The initial addressed-document owner-aware view_document check passes with an addressed-document view_document grant.
The POST-specific addressed-document owner-aware change_document check passes with an addressed-document change_document grant.
Note.objects.create creates a note attached to the addressed document.
The detail notes action admits POST and is protected by PaperlessNotePermissions.
For POST, the permission class requires authenticated status and global documents.add_note, documents.view_document, and documents.change_document permissions.
The owner-aware helper passes the initial view_document check when the addressed document is ownerless or owned by the caller, without an addressed-document view grant.
The POST-specific owner-aware helper passes the change_document check when the addressed document is ownerless or owned by the caller, without an addressed-document change grant.
Note.objects.create creates a note attached to the addressed document after the owner-aware checks pass.
The detail notes action admits POST and is protected by PaperlessNotePermissions.
POST is rejected when authentication or any global documents.add_note, documents.view_document, or documents.change_document permission required by PaperlessNotePermissions fails.
The view returns HTTP 403 when its addressed-document owner-aware view_document check fails.
The POST branch returns HTTP 403 when its addressed-document owner-aware change_document check fails.
